name: @modusensus/euthyna
description: Deterministic fact producers for security auditing: which deleted code came from a security fix, and which changed symbols no test ever executed.
comment: private stays true until the first deliberate publish. Zero runtime dependencies is deliberate: a fact producer that an audit depends on should not itself need a supply-chain review. No third-party files are distributed in this repository; upstream sources are fetched on demand into .refs/ - see NOTICE.md.
